$comment: Not an allowlist. Repositories are discovered from GitHub: any repository the credentials can read with owner activity in the rolling window below. Entries under `projects` are exceptions to that rule — a pin (followed whatever its activity says) and/or an override (displayName, defaultBranch, buildOs, or paths: projectModel / decisions / activeWork / workstreamDir for a repository that keeps its Build OS artifacts somewhere detection would not find them). An empty `projects` list is a working configuration.
